exercise_groups.group_title: TASK 1: NỐI CÂU DÙNG ĐẠI TỪ / TRẠNG TỪ QUAN HỆ (10 CÂU)
exercise_groups.instruction: Nối hai câu sau thành một câu có nghĩa tương đương:

questions.prompt: 1. She is the most intelligent woman. I’ve never met this woman.
answers: the most intelligent woman that I've ever met.
the most intelligent woman that I have ever met.
the most intelligent woman I've ever met.
questions.explanation: Có so sánh nhất 'the most intelligent' nên đại từ quan hệ ưu tiên dùng 'that' (hoặc lược bỏ).

questions.prompt: 2. This doctor is famous. You visited him yesterday.
answers: whom you visited yesterday is famous.
that you visited yesterday is famous.
you visited yesterday is famous.
questions.explanation: 'him' là tân ngữ chỉ người ➔ dùng 'whom' hoặc 'that'.

questions.prompt: 3. These children are orphans. She is taking care of these children.
answers: whom she is taking care of are orphans.
of whom she is taking care are orphans.
that she is taking care of are orphans.
questions.explanation: 'these children' là tân ngữ chỉ người ➔ whom she is taking care of.

questions.prompt: 4. The two young men are not good persons. You are acquainted with them.
answers: with whom you are acquainted are not good persons.
whom you are acquainted with are not good persons.
questions.explanation: Thay thế cho 'them' sau giới từ 'with' ➔ with whom (hoặc whom... with).

questions.prompt: 5. My father goes swimming every day. You met him this morning.
answers: whom you met this morning, goes swimming every day.
questions.explanation: 'My father' là danh từ xác định ➔ mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định có dấu phẩy dùng 'whom'.

questions.prompt: 6. The man is my father. I respect this man most.
answers: whom I respect most is my father.
that I respect most is my father.
I respect most is my father.
questions.explanation: Thay thế cho tân ngữ chỉ người 'this man' ➔ whom / that I respect most.

questions.prompt: 7. The man is my father. I respect his opinion most.
answers: whose opinion I respect most is my father.
questions.explanation: 'his opinion' chỉ sở hữu ➔ dùng 'whose opinion'.

questions.prompt: 8. Mary and Margaret are twins. You met them yesterday.
answers: whom you met yesterday, are twins.
questions.explanation: Tên riêng có dấu phẩy, thay thế cho tân ngữ 'them' ➔ whom you met yesterday.

questions.prompt: 9. I’ll introduce you to the man. His support is necessary for your project.
questions.targetStart: I’ll introduce you to the man
answers: whose support is necessary for your project.
questions.explanation: 'His support' chỉ sở hữu ➔ whose support.

questions.prompt: 10. The middle-aged man is the director. My father is talking to him.
answers: to whom my father is talking is the director.
whom my father is talking to is the director.
questions.explanation: Thay thế cho 'him' đi với giới từ to ➔ to whom my father is talking.

exercise_groups.group_title: TASK 2: LUYỆN TẬP NỐI CÂU MỞ RỘNG (10 CÂU)
exercise_groups.instruction: Nối hai câu sau sử dụng đại từ hoặc trạng từ quan hệ:

questions.prompt: 1. The boy is my cousin. You make fun of him.
answers: whom you make fun of is my cousin.
of whom you make fun is my cousin.
questions.explanation: Thay thế cho 'him' ➔ whom you make fun of.

questions.prompt: 2. The student is from China. He sits next to me.
answers: who sits next to me is from China.
that sits next to me is from China.
questions.explanation: 'He' là chủ ngữ chỉ người ➔ who sits next to me.

questions.prompt: 3. I thanked the woman. This woman had helped me.
answers: who had helped me.
that had helped me.
questions.explanation: 'This woman' là chủ ngữ chỉ người ➔ who had helped me.

questions.prompt: 4. The professor is excellent. I am taking his course.
answers: whose course I am taking is excellent.
questions.explanation: 'his course' chỉ sở hữu ➔ whose course I am taking.

questions.prompt: 5. Mr. Smith said he was too busy to speak to me. I had come to see him.
answers: whom I had come to see, said he was too busy to speak to me.
questions.explanation: Tên riêng có dấu phẩy, thay thế cho tân ngữ 'him' ➔ whom I had come to see.

questions.prompt: 6. I saw a lot of people and horses. They went to market.
questions.targetStart: I saw a lot of people and horses
answers: that went to market.
questions.explanation: Tiền từ gồm cả người và động vật ('people and horses') bắt buộc dùng 'that'.

questions.prompt: 7. Tom has three sisters. All of them are married.
answers: all of whom are married.
questions.explanation: Sau từ chỉ số lượng có giới từ 'all of' thay thế cho người ➔ all of whom.

questions.prompt: 8. I recently went back to Paris. It is still as beautiful as a pearl.
questions.targetStart: I recently went back to Paris,
answers: which is still as beautiful as a pearl.
questions.explanation: Thay thế cho 'It' (chủ ngữ chỉ thành phố Paris) ➔ which is still as beautiful...

questions.prompt: 9. I recently went back to Paris. I was born in Paris nearly 50 years ago.
questions.targetStart: I recently went back to Paris,
answers: where I was born nearly 50 years ago.
questions.explanation: Thay thế cho cụm trạng từ chỉ nơi chốn 'in Paris' ➔ where I was born...

questions.prompt: 10. Do you know the music? It is being played on the radio.
answers: which is being played on the radio?
that is being played on the radio?
questions.explanation: 'the music' là danh từ chỉ vật ➔ which / that is being played on the radio.

exercise_groups.group_title: TASK 3: NỐI CÂU NÂNG CAO (10 CÂU)
exercise_groups.instruction: Nối hai câu sau sử dụng đại từ hoặc trạng từ quan hệ:

questions.prompt: 1. You didn’t tell us the reason. We have to cut down our daily expenses for that reason.
questions.targetStart: You didn’t tell us the reason
answers: why we have to cut down our daily expenses.
questions.explanation: 'the reason' chỉ lý do ➔ dùng trạng từ 'why'.

questions.prompt: 2. The day was rainy. She left on that day.
answers: when she left was rainy.
on which she left was rainy.
questions.explanation: 'The day' chỉ thời gian ➔ when she left (hoặc on which she left).

questions.prompt: 3. I’ve sent him two letters. He has received neither of them.
answers: neither of which he has received.
questions.explanation: Sau 'neither of' thay thế cho đồ vật 'letters' ➔ neither of which.

questions.prompt: 4. That man is an artist. I don’t remember the man’s name.
answers: whose name I don't remember, is an artist.
questions.explanation: 'the man's name' chỉ sở hữu ➔ whose name I don't remember.

questions.prompt: 5. One of the elephants had only one tusk. We saw these elephants at the zoo.
answers: which we saw at the zoo had only one tusk.
that we saw at the zoo had only one tusk.
questions.explanation: Thay thế cho tân ngữ chỉ động vật 'these elephants' ➔ which/that we saw at the zoo.

questions.prompt: 6. That car belongs to Dr. Clark. Its engine is very good.
answers: whose engine is very good, belongs to Dr. Clark.
questions.explanation: 'Its engine' chỉ sở hữu đồ vật ➔ whose engine is very good.

questions.prompt: 7. You sent me a present. Thank you very much for it.
questions.targetStart: Thank you very much for the present
answers: which you sent me.
that you sent me.
you sent me.
questions.explanation: Thay thế cho 'the present' chỉ vật ➔ which you sent me.

questions.prompt: 8. This is Mrs. Jones. Her son won the championship last year.
answers: whose son won the championship last year.
questions.explanation: 'Her son' chỉ sở hữu ➔ whose son won the championship last year.

questions.prompt: 9. Rod Lee has won an Oscar. I know his sister.
answers: whose sister I know, has won an Oscar.
questions.explanation: 'his sister' chỉ sở hữu ➔ whose sister I know.

questions.prompt: 10. Is this the style of hair? Your wife wants to have it.
questions.targetStart: Is this the style of hair
answers: which your wife wants to have?
that your wife wants to have?
questions.explanation: 'style of hair' chỉ vật ➔ which / that your wife wants to have?

exercise_groups.group_title: TASK 4: NỐI CÂU ĐẶC BIỆT & THAY THẾ CẢ MỆNH ĐỀ (5 CÂU)
exercise_groups.instruction: Nối hai câu sau sử dụng đại từ hoặc trạng từ quan hệ:

questions.prompt: 1. A man answered the phone. He said Tom was out.
answers: who answered the phone said Tom was out.
that answered the phone said Tom was out.
questions.explanation: 'He' là chủ ngữ chỉ người ➔ who answered the phone.

questions.prompt: 2. 7.05 is the time. My plane arrives then.
answers: when my plane arrives.
questions.explanation: 'the time' chỉ thời gian ➔ when my plane arrives.

questions.prompt: 3. Max isn’t home yet. That worries me.
answers: which worries me.
questions.explanation: Dùng 'which' sau dấu phẩy để thay thế cho cả một mệnh đề đứng trước ('Max isn't home yet').

questions.prompt: 4. Do you know the building? The windows of the building are painted green.
answers: whose windows are painted green?
the windows of which are painted green?
questions.explanation: 'The windows of the building' chỉ sở hữu ➔ whose windows are painted green?

questions.prompt: 5. Last week I went to see the house. I used to live in it.
questions.targetStart: Last week I went to see the house
answers: where I used to live.
in which I used to live.
questions.explanation: 'in it' chỉ nơi chốn ➔ where I used to live (hoặc in which I used to live).

exercise_groups.group_title: TASK 5: SỬ DỤNG TRẠNG TỪ QUAN HỆ (WHERE / WHEN / WHY) (10 CÂU)
exercise_groups.instruction: Sử dụng trạng từ quan hệ thích hợp để nối câu:

questions.prompt: 1. This is the house. We often stay in this house in summer.
answers: where we often stay in summer.
questions.explanation: 'in this house' chỉ nơi chốn ➔ where we often stay in summer.

questions.prompt: 2. I’ll show you the second-hand bookshop. You can find valuable books in this shop.
questions.targetStart: I’ll show you the second-hand bookshop
answers: where you can find valuable books.
questions.explanation: 'in this shop' chỉ nơi chốn ➔ where you can find valuable books.

questions.prompt: 3. I have not decided the day. I’ll go to London on that day.
questions.targetStart: I have not decided the day
answers: when I'll go to London.
questions.explanation: 'on that day' chỉ thời gian ➔ when I'll go to London.

questions.prompt: 4. He was born on the day. His father was away on that day.
questions.targetStart: He was born on the day
answers: when his father was away.
questions.explanation: 'on that day' chỉ thời gian ➔ when his father was away.

questions.prompt: 5. The book is a telephone directory. We can look up telephone numbers in this book.
answers: where we can look up telephone numbers is a telephone directory.
in which we can look up telephone numbers is a telephone directory.
questions.explanation: 'in this book' được xem như vị trí tra cứu ➔ where we can look up telephone numbers.

questions.prompt: 6. Mrs. Brown rang Dr. Brown. He was going to carry out an urgent operation at that moment.
answers: when he was going to carry out an urgent operation.
questions.explanation: 'at that moment' chỉ thời điểm ➔ when he was going to carry out...

questions.prompt: 7. The airport is the most modern one. We’re going to arrive at this airport.
answers: where we're going to arrive is the most modern one.
questions.explanation: 'at this airport' chỉ nơi chốn ➔ where we're going to arrive.

questions.prompt: 8. She doesn’t want to speak of the cause. She divorced her husband of this cause.
questions.targetStart: She doesn’t want to speak of the cause
answers: why she divorced her husband.
questions.explanation: 'the cause' chỉ nguyên nhân lý do ➔ why she divorced her husband.

questions.prompt: 9. The days were the saddest ones. I lived far from home on those days.
answers: when I lived far from home were the saddest ones.
questions.explanation: 'on those days' chỉ thời gian ➔ when I lived far from home.

questions.prompt: 10. I never forget the park. We met each other for the first time at this park.
answers: where we met each other for the first time.
questions.explanation: 'at this park' chỉ nơi chốn ➔ where we met each other for the first time.

exercise_groups.group_title: TASK 6: GIỚI TỪ ĐỨNG TRƯỚC ĐẠI TỪ QUAN HỆ (PREPOSITION + WHOM / WHICH) (10 CÂU)
exercise_groups.instruction: Đưa giới từ lên trước đại từ quan hệ (whom / which):

questions.prompt: 1. This is a rare opportunity. You should take advantage of it to get a better job.
answers: of which you should take advantage to get a better job.
questions.explanation: 'take advantage of it' ➔ of which you should take advantage...

questions.prompt: 2. The boy is my cousin. You made fun of him.
answers: of whom you made fun is my cousin.
questions.explanation: 'make fun of him' ➔ of whom you made fun is my cousin.

questions.prompt: 3. This matter is of great importance. You should pay attention to it.
answers: to which you should pay attention is of great importance.
questions.explanation: 'pay attention to it' ➔ to which you should pay attention...

questions.prompt: 4. The woman lives next door to me. You gave place to her on the bus.
answers: to whom you gave place on the bus lives next door to me.
questions.explanation: 'gave place to her' ➔ to whom you gave place on the bus...

questions.prompt: 5. The examination lasted two days. I was successful in this examination.
answers: in which I was successful lasted two days.
questions.explanation: 'successful in this examination' ➔ in which I was successful...

questions.prompt: 6. This is the result of our work. I’m pleased with it.
questions.targetStart: This is the result of our work
answers: with which I'm pleased.
with which I am pleased.
questions.explanation: 'pleased with it' ➔ with which I'm pleased.

questions.prompt: 7. There is a No Parking sign. I do not take notice of it.
questions.targetStart: There is a No Parking sign
answers: of which I do not take notice.
of which I don't take notice.
questions.explanation: 'take notice of it' ➔ of which I do not take notice.

questions.prompt: 8. Mr. Brown is the man. I am responsible to him for my work.
answers: to whom I am responsible for my work.
questions.explanation: 'responsible to him' ➔ to whom I am responsible for my work.

questions.prompt: 9. Do you see my pen? I have just written the lesson with it.
answers: with which I have just written the lesson?
questions.explanation: 'written with it' ➔ with which I have just written the lesson?

questions.prompt: 10. We are crossing the meadow. We flew kites over it in our childhood.
answers: over which we flew kites in our childhood.
questions.explanation: 'flew kites over it' ➔ over which we flew kites in our childhood.
